product.name: Arthur Platform
product.description: An API-driven platform for evaluating, monitoring, governing, and improving traditional ML, generative AI, and agentic AI systems across development, runtime, and production.

product.name: Arthur Evals Engine
product.description: A deployable evaluation and guardrail engine that runs alongside customer workloads to assess AI performance, enforce runtime policies, and keep sensitive inference data within the customer environment.

product.name: AI Evaluation and Monitoring Services
product.description: Evaluation and monitoring capabilities for measuring AI quality, reliability, risk, and operational performance throughout the AI lifecycle.

product.name: AI Governance and Observability Services
product.description: Enterprise services that help organizations discover AI systems, apply policy-based governance, monitor behavior, and integrate evaluation workflows into production operations.
